raw_sections.Description:
MSI Cyborg 15 Max C2WE is a gaming laptop featuring a Raptor Lake i7-13620H processor, NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5050 Laptop GPU, GDDR7 8GB graphics, DDR5 16GB memory, 512GB NVMe PCIe SSD Gen4x4 w/o DRAM storage, and a 15.6" FHD (1920*1080), 144Hz 100%sRGB IPS-Level display, making it a gaming laptop available in Egypt through Compumarts.
